result.summary: Found 2 visual issues on the food delivery app page: one truncated restaurant name and one partially visible category filter button.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' in the 'Fastest near you' section is truncated/cut off. The full name is not visible due to insufficient card width or text overflow handling.
issues.suggestion: Either reduce the font size, allow text wrapping to a second line, or implement a tooltip/ellipsis that still shows the full name on hover or truncates gracefully with '...' to indicate more text exists.

issues.description: The last category filter pill (rightmost) in the horizontal scroll row is partially cut off, showing only a sliver of a button after 'Healthy', giving no visual indication it is scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle fade/gradient on the right edge of the filter row to indicate horizontal scrollability, or ensure the partial pill is more visible to hint at scrollable content.
